subject: [PATCH v5 05/12] mm/mmzone: read the zoneref slot once in zonelist_zone()

2026-11-01.patch_summary: This patch updates the zonelist_zone() function to use READ_ONCE() when loading a zone from a zoneref slot, ensuring that the loaded zone is not changed by memory hotplug rebuilds of the zonelists. This prevents issues where a caller checks one zone and then uses another or the NULL terminator due to multiple loads of the same slot. The patch addresses a problem introduced in a previous commit (11cd8638c37f) that removed stop_machine from build_all_zonelists.

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary: Identified the patch as correct and suitable for merge. Acknowledged its fix for potential double-put bugs in memory hotplug scenarios.
reviews.raw_body:
On Sat Oct 31, 2026 at 10:13 PM EDT, Gregory Price (Meta) wrote:
> Memory hotplug rebuilds zonelists in place while allocations walk them,
> so a zoneref slot can change between two loads of it.
>
> zonelist_zone() loads the slot with a plain access.  The compiler may
> load it again later instead of keeping the zone it already read, so a
> caller can check one zone and then use another, or the NULL terminator.
>
> Use READ_ONCE().  Callers that take a zone from a slot and keep using
> it, such as get_page_from_freelist() with ac->preferred_zoneref, need
> that single load.
>
> Fixes: 11cd8638c37f ("mm, page_alloc: remove stop_machine from build_all_zonelists")
> Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
> Signed-off-by: Gregory Price (Meta) <gourry@gourry.net>
> ---
>  include/linux/mmzone.h | 3 ++-
>  1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)
>

LGTM.

Acked-by: Zi Yan <ziy@nvidia.com>

Best Regards,
Yan, Zi

2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch addresses a memory hotplug issue where zonelists are rebuilt in place, causing potential double-put bugs when accessing the zoneref slot. It uses READ_ONCE() to ensure that the zone is loaded only once.
